mapper.insert: insert into points_goods (name, description, image, points_required, stock, total_exchanged, status, sort_order) values (#{name}, #{description}, #{image}, #{pointsRequired}, #{stock}, #{totalExchanged}, #{status}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: select * from points_goods where status = 1 and stock > 0 order by sort_order asc
mapper.update: update points_goods set stock = stock - 1, total_exchanged = total_exchanged + 1, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and stock > 0
